entities.title: Structural examples
entities.summary: Named UTV values that are structurally valid (valid.json, 31 values covering 24 of the 26 core kinds) or must be rejected (invalid-structural.json, 8 values).
entities.purpose: Shows what well-formed and malformed UTV JSON looks like, and lets tools/validate.py and each library's structural validator prove they accept and reject the same values.
boundaries: Structure only: a value in valid.json may still be semantically invalid or unresolvable (new-york-gap-intention resolves to no instant).
